concepts.name: Paloma y libro
concepts.description: Una paloma alza el vuelo desde un libro abierto.

request.prompt: Draw a clearly recognizable DOVE taking flight diagonally up and right from a clearly recognizable OPEN BOOK. The bird has a small rounded head, a short beak, one broad raised wing and a short fan-shaped tail. The open book is low and wide with two substantial curved pages and a deep central fold. Compose bird and book as one memorable compact brand silhouette, with the wing extending up from the book fold. The dove is airborne, not perched. Use navy #174765 for the dove and muted sea blue #6B9BB2 for the book. This must look like an elegant original bird-and-book emblem, not an abstract geometric puzzle. No circular seal, wreath, oval frame, lettering, thin feather details or imitation of the reference bird silhouette.
request.instructions: Create a fresh original logo SYMBOL for hUMAnos, a hackathon team from Universidad de Málaga (UMA). The supplied reference is the official university logo and is provided only to understand its navy academic character, bird symbolism and scholarly mood. DO NOT copy, trace, recreate or closely rearrange the official emblem. Use the new subject and composition described in the prompt. The user wants an immediately recognizable concrete subject, crafted like an elegant illustrated brand mark. Do not substitute abstract loops, initials, geometric people, pseudo-letters or meaningless swooshes for the named subject. Compose one bold compact symbol that also remains identifiable as a 16px favicon. Use broad silhouettes, substantial negative space and very few large details. Square 512x512 SVG viewBox, centered artwork, about 48 units of clear padding. Fully transparent canvas; no background rectangle, white tile, frame or badge. Flat opaque filled vector paths and basic shapes only. Two colors maximum. No raster images, gradients, shadows, filters, fonts, scripts or external assets. No words or text: the exact hUMAnos wordmark will be added separately. No university seal text, decorative wreath or ring of lettering.

concepts.name: Manos al vuelo
concepts.description: Una mano abierta impulsa una paloma.

request.prompt: Draw a clearly recognizable OPEN HUMAN HAND gently releasing a small DOVE. The hand is a broad cupped palm viewed from the side, with a clear thumb notch and a single clean contour for the joined fingers; it rises diagonally from lower left. The dove hovers just above the palm, head and short beak pointing right, with a broad uplifted wing and a small split tail. Make the hand and bird create a welcoming, upward compact composition that expresses human support and shared knowledge. Use navy #1B4558 for the hand and deep turquoise #4E9C9B for the bird. A refined illustrative logo made from bold silhouettes, not a literal detailed drawing. No heart, handshake, official university seal, circle border, text or tiny feather and finger details.

request.prompt: Draw a clearly recognizable OPEN BOOK from whose central fold a single OLIVE BRANCH grows upwards and curves gently to the right. The book has two broad solid pages and one crisp V-shaped central fold. The olive branch has a substantial curved stem and exactly five large almond-shaped leaves, arranged asymmetrically. The branch must be an open sprig, never a circular wreath. This is an original Mediterranean university-team identity expressing learning and growth. Use deep blue-slate #254D5C for the book and muted olive #8B9959 for the branch. Strong filled silhouettes, a generous uncluttered outline, no microscopic olive fruits, page lines, seal, circular frame, letters or text.

request.prompt: Draw a clearly recognizable MEDITERRANEAN LIGHTHOUSE as a compact university-team emblem. A stout gently tapered tower with a small simple lantern roof, one broad negative-space window, and a strong foundation shaped like two open book pages. A single bold golden wedge of light projects to the upper right from the lantern; this is the one accent. The book foundation also subtly suggests a calm sea horizon. The lighthouse should be friendly, architectural and unmistakable at a tiny size, representing knowledge as guidance in coastal Malaga. Use deep blue #214C70 for the tower and book, warm gold #D0A34D for the beam. No round badge, coast scene, sun, tiny railings, brickwork, outlines, letters or text.
